pages.title: The beta in four builds

facts.value: the Oct 15 block was posted Oct 16 at 00:15 UTC, the largest of the four
the Skyborne and Zephras Isle, Hall of Thanes (13 to 18), Ruins of Lordaeron (15 to 20), every zone up to 20; a free server slam promised
barber chairs errored; guild charters could not be signed, so charters were accepted with zero signatures; character friends off; minimap could sit partly off screen
two WoW licenses on one Battle.net account kicked each other off in the first week

respec 1 silver (beta only); Cooldown Manager added, off by default; heal-over-time spells can crit; wands stop scaling with spell damage; Wizard Oils to Classic values; Gnome Eureka a 10% discount on Mana, Rage or Energy abilities; Touch of the Grave stops breaking crowd control; dungeon quests unshareable; faster starter-zone respawns; party changes may move players to another world instance

level cap 30; Excavation Site opened; Razorfen Downs and Uldaman opened; dungeon quest bonus XP cut 50%; crafted wands vendor for 1 copper; fewer starter copper veins; most Honor costs up about 50%; Honor cap 15,000 to 25,000; downranking penalty shown on the character sheet; warrior rebuild; Hot Streak renamed Heating Up and Combustion back to 3 charges; barbers hired; Ray Traced Shadows removed
botting and gold-buying accounts actioned in the beta, announced the same day as the cap-30 notes

dungeon mob XP up about 20%; party kill XP by each player's own level; City of Dalaran opened; Classic looting back; Rage rebuilt (three bugs including more Stamina meaning less Rage); druid crit Rage +100% and bear threat 30% to 50%; Thorns and Retribution Aura to vanilla values; every new rank of Frostbolt, Fireball, Smite, Lightning Bolt and Shadow Bolt an upgrade; 16 Legacy points granted; Discord voice in Audio settings; Group Finder voice mode; capital barbers replaced by locals

weapon-skill racials became flat bonuses (Human +2% crit, Orc +1% crit, Dwarf +2% crit damage and healing); Troll Regeneration 10% to 20%; Skyborne haste 1% to 3%; Blood Fury cooldown 2 to 3 min; Battle Shout, Trueshot Aura, Moonkin Aura, Leader of the Pack and four shaman totems raid-wide; wands and Auto Shot need 0.5 s still; mage Frost Blast at 24, Arcane rebuilt, Ice Lance +300% to +200%; Salvation no longer a Blessing; Consecration per-tick coefficient 0.095 to 0.042; Elemental Mastery the 31-point medal; Chain Lightning about 35% cheaper; Grim Reach replaced Malediction; Horde attacked on sight in Dalaran; scrolls trigger the global cooldown
post 7 of the dev-notes thread, by Kaivax (Community Manager), 2026-10-26 20:35 UTC; racials only

Human Ruthless 2% to 1% crit, Human Spirit 5% to 10%; Dwarf Earth Fury (+2% crit damage and healing) removed, Artisan's Precision (+1% spell and attack hit) added; Tauren Plainsrunning 1% to 2% per stack (cap 30% to 60%) with no mounted speed, Endurance only +5% health; Orc Savage (+1% crit) removed, Command re-added (+5% Warlock and Hunter pet damage); Skyborne Wind-Blessed 3% to 2% haste, Read Leyline +100% to +50% regen for 15 s plus Attuned (1 hour, back to +100%) when used at a Ley Line, Skysight +10% to +15% speed for 15 s plus Charged (1 hour, +30%) when used at an elemental convergence; Attuned and Charged persist through death

racial identity over generic traits, so some races end up slightly better at certain combat roles; generic replacements of role- or class-focused racials rolled back, except weapon specialization racials (Human Sword, Orc Axe), which stay removed so future loot tables are not judged by "required" weapon types; a tuning pass on the remaining passives
10 minutes to 1 minute, client data not in the notes (datamine)
100% of Intellect, then 60% (Oct 1), 30% (Oct 15), back to 60% by hotfix (client data, Oct 18)
Holy threat 90%, to 60% (Sep 24), back to 90% (Oct 15)
16-point medal (Oct 7), 2-point row 1 talent with an Arcane Missiles trigger (Oct 15), trigger removed by hotfix Oct 16, Frost Blast added as a trigger Oct 18 (client data for the last two)
two different redesigns in the same Oct 15 notes; client files carry the first, the server hotfix the second
chairs broken (Sep 17), barbers hired everywhere (Oct 1), all capital barbers replaced (Oct 8)
warrior +75% then +100% inside one Oct 1 post; druid +75% (Oct 1) then +100% (Oct 8)
about 700 talent changes since the BlizzCon build, 95 for mages (datamine)
280 measured changes; 101 of 151 claims in the notes matched the client tables (datamine)
1M+ characters: Hunter most played at 15.6%, Warlock least at 9%, Skyborne the most chosen race at 18.7%; rarest Troll Warrior and Dwarf Priest 0.4%, Dwarf Rogue 0.2%
$100,000 level 30 tournament Oct 17 to 18; warlocks took 1st and 2nd; the winner took $50,000 from 4,673 qualifier matches
about 856,600 views on the dev-notes thread by Oct 19
the Oct 15 notes remove a priest talent named Shadow Infinity, which exists in no build; client data shows Shadow Affinity left
